subgroups.name: early_within_subject_iteration_jan2026
subgroups.hypothesis: H: the initial within-subject pipeline (binary + ternary) produces signal above chance on a subset of subjects
subgroups.rationale: All from January 2026 with empty command fields and rapid iteration cadence (multiple runs per night). Predates cross_subject infrastructure (docs/dev_log/2026-02-05_cross_subject_infrastructure.md) and model_selection plan. No documentation references these specific timestamps; pattern indicates exploratory pipeline bring-up runs.

subgroups.name: within_subject_sweep_feb2026
subgroups.hypothesis: H: iterated within-subject runs while refactoring serialization / cache will produce a reproducible reference accuracy
subgroups.rationale: Feb 3-10 cluster overlaps with cache + cross_subject infrastructure refactor (docs/dev_log/2026-02-05_*). 20260205_0306 and 20260206_1003 are cited as historical-best ternary/binary standalone references in unified_model_results_report.md §2. Empty command fields = pre-CLI-logging era.

subgroups.name: early_cross_subject_bringup
subgroups.hypothesis: H: the newly built cross-subject training/comparison pipeline produces sensible group accuracy
subgroups.rationale: docs/dev_log/2026-02-05_cross_subject_infrastructure.md documents the cross-subject infrastructure landing 2026-02-05; these runs are the first cross_subject entries in the CSV (immediately after). 20260207_2056 cited as historical ternary cross reference in baseline_registry.md §CBraMod Ternary.

subgroups.name: early_transfer_bringup_feb2026
subgroups.hypothesis: H: cross-subject -> per-subject fine-tune (transfer paradigm) yields accuracy gains over cross-subject alone
subgroups.rationale: First transfer_imagery_binary runs in the CSV; empty command field. Same week as cross_subject infrastructure landing. No docs reference these tags individually; intent inferred from being the inaugural transfer cohort.

subgroups.name: data_leak_debug_mar1
subgroups.hypothesis: H: the high accuracy seen on FDR-complement 32ch is not driven by a binary-task data-leakage path in the cross-subject pipeline
subgroups.rationale: MEMORY.md 'FDR 补集通道实验 (2026-03-01)' explicitly logs this date as a data-leakage investigation; docs/dev_log/experiments/data_quality_analysis.md is dated 2026-03-01. Runs cluster on that exact day across cross_subject + within_subject pipelines.

subgroups.name: within_subject_eegnet_quick_check_mar16
subgroups.hypothesis: H: EEGNet within-subject binary script runs end-to-end after recent refactor
subgroups.rationale: Two back-to-back identical commands (--models eegnet --task binary) one minute apart imply a smoke retry, not a sweep. EEGNet baseline 20260316_1411 (9 minutes later) is the first post-HPO production run per baseline_registry.md, so these two predate it.

subgroups.name: unified_model_smoke_then_full_mar19_20
subgroups.hypothesis: H: the unified (binary+ternary+quaternary) head trains end-to-end with default params before HPO
subgroups.rationale: docs/dev_log/experiments/unified_model_results_report.md §1.4 records 2026-03-19 default-param unified runs (20260319_1640, 20260319_2102); S01-S02 subsets indicate explicit smoke tests preceding full-subject runs. HPO-optimized unified baselines 20260320_0243/20260320_0548 are not in this CSV (baselines excluded). 20260320_0241 is the within unified default-param full run.

subgroups.name: model_selection_strategy_sweep_mar21
subgroups.hypothesis: H: alternative checkpoint-selection strategies (val_acc-only / EMA / model-soup) outperform the default combined_score for CBraMod within/cross/transfer binary
subgroups.rationale: docs/model_selection_experiment_plan.md defines exactly these four strategies. Commands reference configs/model_selection_val_acc.yaml, model_selection_ema.yaml, model_selection_soup.yaml. Triplet appears across within (3), cross (4: default + 3 strategies), and transfer (3 strategies, sharing 20260321_0608 pretrained ckpt).

subgroups.name: dapt_v1_first_evaluation_mar22
subgroups.hypothesis: H: a CBraMod backbone further-pretrained on motor-imagery datasets (V1 DAPT) outperforms the TUEG-only baseline at cross-subject binary
subgroups.rationale: Commands use --output-dir checkpoints/cross_subject/eval_baseline vs eval_further_pretrained -- pairwise A/B of original vs further-pretrained init. paper/analysis/further_pretraining_analysis.md (V1/V2 DAPT analysis) is cited in 2026-05-10_dapt_v4_v5.md as the historical record of this comparison; results/pretraining/20260322_*_evaluation_comparison.json files match these tags.

subgroups.name: script_unification_replication_mar23
subgroups.hypothesis: H: the unified-rewrite of run_{within,cross}_subject_comparison.py reproduces prior results on a 2-subject smoke before full-cohort runs
subgroups.rationale: All four commands use --subjects S01 S02 --force-retrain --no-plot --cache-only -- classic 2-subject smoke pattern. Same day produced full-cohort baseline replacements 20260323_2237/20260323_2320/20260324_0023/20260324_0109 (baseline_registry.md update history 2026-03-24).

subgroups.name: transfer_pure_hpo_config_replication_mar29
subgroups.hypothesis: H: removing get_default_finetune_config() and running transfer with pure within-subject HPO config matches prior transfer baselines
subgroups.rationale: baseline_registry.md 2026-03-29 entry. The 0507/0521 baselines superseded these; 20260329_0431 (binary) and 20260329_0448 (ternary) are immediate predecessors using the same --pretrained-cbramod 20260324_0023/0109 ckpts but pre-baseline.

subgroups.name: extra_sessions_5subj_transfer_mar30
subgroups.hypothesis: H: pretraining cross-subject with extra Online sessions (Sess03-05) included does not regress transfer accuracy on the 5 subjects who have those sessions
subgroups.rationale: All four runs use --subjects S01 S05 S12 S20 S21 (subset with extra sessions). Pretrained ckpt names contain sess05 vs baseline suffixes, indicating an A/B between sess05-augmented vs baseline cross-subject inits.

subgroups.name: eegnet_transfer_baseline_followups_may5_7
subgroups.hypothesis: H: an EEGNet transfer reference run exists at n=21 to fill the missing EEGNet binary/ternary transfer baseline cell
subgroups.rationale: baseline_registry.md '缺失 Baseline' table lists EEGNet binary/ternary transfer as missing; 2026-05-09_random_init_ablation.md cites 20260507_1835/20260507_1913 as the closest n=21 EEGNet transfer reference. All six commands share --pretrained-eegnet 20260330_0709/0735 ckpts -> repeated retries of same config.

subgroups.name: leave_3_out_sensitivity_may5
subgroups.hypothesis: H: removing the 3 high-artifact subjects (S04/S10/S14) does not collapse cross-subject CBraMod headline accuracy
subgroups.rationale: docs/handoffs/2026-05-04_overnight_experiments.md §3 Task B specifies leaving out S04/S10/S14; commands list exactly the 18 retained subjects and write to results/sensitivity_leave3out/. Binary + ternary pair matches Task B's two-subtask spec.

subgroups.name: dapt_v3_downstream_eval_may5
subgroups.hypothesis: H: DAPT V3 (Stieger downweighted to ~30%) reverses the V1/V2 negative transfer on cross-subject binary/ternary
subgroups.rationale: docs/handoffs/2026-05-04_overnight_experiments.md §5 Task D defines V3; both commands use --further-pretrained-cbramod .../further_pretrain_v3_continued_20260505_1800/best_model.pth and write to results/dapt_v3.

subgroups.name: cbramod_random_init_ablation_may8_9
subgroups.hypothesis: H: a from-scratch (no foundation-model pretraining) CBraMod loses substantial accuracy vs the foundation-pretrained baseline, isolating pretraining contribution
subgroups.rationale: docs/handoffs/2026-05-09_random_init_ablation.md lists all 6 runs by tag with explicit --no-pretrained flag; commands match exactly. 20260509_1229 repeats within_ternary; 20260509_1838 is the seed=1234 reproducibility check.

subgroups.name: eegnet_huge_capacity_ablation_may9
subgroups.hypothesis: H: scaling EEGNet capacity toward CBraMod parameter count (20-30M, then 5.84M/1.90M with LayerNorm) closes the foundation-model gap
subgroups.rationale: docs/handoffs/2026-05-09_eegnet_huge.md documents v1/v2/v3/Mid configs with these exact run_tags. 20260509_0016 is the eegnet_huge_smoke single-subject pre-flight.

subgroups.name: dapt_v4_v5_downstream_may10
subgroups.hypothesis: H: DAPT V4 (3-set + strict filter) or V5 (Stieger-only single-channel-count) eliminates the V1-V3 negative transfer on the full {within,cross,transfer}x{binary,ternary} matrix
subgroups.rationale: docs/handoffs/2026-05-10_dapt_v4_v5.md lists all V4/V5 run_tags by cell, including the duplicate launch of V4 cross/ternary (20260510_1019 then 20260510_1020). within+transfer 8-cell runs and the explicit V4/V5 checkpoint paths in commands match.

subgroups.name: label_shuffle_negative_control_may10
subgroups.hypothesis: H: shuffling within-subject trial labels collapses cross-subject CBraMod accuracy to chance, ruling out data leakage
subgroups.rationale: docs/handoffs/2026-05-10_p03_label_shuffle_results.md (P0.3 control) documents both runs by tag with seed 42/123. Commands carry --shuffle-labels --shuffle-seed N and tags carry the _labelshuffle_seedN suffix.

subgroups.name: dapt_v1_v2_v3_transfer_backfill_may10_11
subgroups.hypothesis: H: per-subject transfer fine-tuning rescues the V1/V2/V3 DAPT negative effect observed at cross-subject, completing the 18-cell DAPT failure matrix
subgroups.rationale: docs/handoffs/2026-05-10_dapt_v4_v5.md '追加 (2026-05-11)' section lists all six tags with their V1/V2/V3 source checkpoints. Output dirs results/dapt_v{1,2,3} match.

subgroups.name: paper_figure_regeneration_may12
subgroups.hypothesis: H: rerunning the comparison scripts on cached predictions regenerates paper figures with the latest plotting style
subgroups.rationale: 20260512_0851 uses --skip-training (replot mode, no DB entry per MEMORY feedback_replot_no_db_entry); the other three use plain --cache-only with no model/subject args. Output is for paper figure refresh, not new experimental data.
